scope: Paper cut-edge response and relief construction/material controls; one unchanged satin-front renderer sanity control. No renewed acceptance claim for all eight material cases.

review_evidence.authority: Explicit root task acceptance after direct visual inspection
review_evidence.manufacturer_photos: Viewed privately; linked reference sources only, no manufacturer pixels redistributed

limitations: Gmund600 gsm approximately1 mm is published approximate stock guidance, not measurement of the rendered sample. The300 gsm/.5 mm variant is an authored estimate.

Cut-edge normal/color/roughness fields are analytic optical estimates at8×2 mm repeat. No displacement is used; the straight silhouette remains unchanged. These are not a measured cut-edge scan or frayed-fiber geometry.
The .16 mm shoulder and .12 mm relief height/depth are artist-authored controls, not calibrated paper compression,press pressure or manufacturing simulation.
The reference circle is depressed. Positive emboss is retained as a deliberate sign comparison; the negative companion changes only sign at equal magnitude.
Raking light and whole-camera changes are recorded. The first two whole frames are rejected for clipping and retained, not silently replaced.
The .25 edge and .08 shoulder remain inconclusive history. Exact earlier definitions were archived before revising the same physical copies.
Satin is one unchanged saved-control sanity replay, not a full eight-material re-review.
Actual samples are separate from requested budgets; completion alone is not visual acceptance.
Project-relative image/EXR/render-record/archive paths refer to the portable study package. Only the eight listed unaltered PNGs are included in the public repository evidence.

client_failures_retained.scope: Failed before project mutation; retried with authorized local IPC access.
Failed before finish changes; supported sequential commands resumed on retained copy.
Compacted and retried; no render or specimen mutation involved.
